# Lay-n-Go (layngo.com)

> Patented drawstring organizers that open flat for full visibility and cinch closed for storage and travel.

Lay-n-Go sells organizational solutions for cosmetics, travel, play, pets, nails, and tactical/outdoor use. Founded by Amy and Adam Fazackerley. 16+ years in business. U.S. utility patents protect the open-flat, cinch-closed design.

## How the product works

Lay-n-Go is a drawstring mat/bag hybrid: spread it flat to see and use all contents, then pull the drawstring to cinch everything closed for storage or travel. Used for makeup, toys/LEGO cleanup, toiletries, tech cables, pet travel, nail tools, and tactical gear.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is Lay-n-Go's best seller?
A: The Lay-n-Go Cosmo 20" cosmetic/makeup bag — opens flat, cinches closed.

Q: What is the return policy?
A: 14 days from delivery; items must be unused with original packaging. Email info@layngo.com for a Return Authorization before shipping back.

Q: How does shipping work?
A: Economy 5–8 business days, Standard 3–4, Express 1–2 after the order ships. U.S. and international options at checkout.

Q: How does the product work?
A: A patented drawstring mat opens flat for full visibility, then cinches into a bag for storage or travel.

Q: Wholesale and bulk orders?
